name: AE Snap Report
description: Daily high-level dashboard of Annual Enrollment progress: employer selection status, election-type breakdown, daily timeline, YoY comparison, and Synod/Region breakdown.

feeds.description: Status / Synod-Region / Election Sub-Type / Date / Year. Timeline rows (Date populated) now carry Year too (2026 or 2027, added 2026-09-14) -- the Timeline renders as a cumulative line chart plus a daily-volume bar chart (2026-09-18), scoped to Completed EL/Completed OTP only. Election Sub-Type also carries the 5 Election_Status values (Open/Completed EL/Completed OTP/Default/Default Override, added 2026-09-17) for the 'By Election Status' panel, 'HSA Annual YoY'/'HSA One-Time YoY' (added 2026-09-18, Year-tagged, EmployeeCount repurposed to carry SUM($)) for the Year-over-Year panel, and 'Eligible Count'/'Covered Count' (Year-tagged, EmployeeCount repurposed to carry SUM(EligibleCount)/SUM(HealthCoveredCount), 'Covered Count' added 2026-09-23 alongside a source switch to vDimEmployer for both) for the 'Eligible Lives'/'Covered Lives' YoY stats -- all matched by value against closed vocabularies, same disambiguation pattern as every other multiplexed row-kind here.

Deprecated 2026-09-10 — no longer read by the widget. Timeline data now rides inside employerStatus's Date dimension instead (SAC's Builder UI can only bind one model per widget). Kept declared for manifest compatibility only.

Deprecated 2026-09-11 — no longer read by the widget. This binding's original design (Benefit Type / Changed Flag) is dead; the real YoY panel (health-plan bucket comparison, HSA collapse, eligible-count delta) now rides inside employerStatus's Election Sub-Type/Year dimensions instead (same one-model-per-widget limitation as dailyCounts). Kept declared for manifest compatibility only.

refresh.description: Re-renders the dashboard from the currently bound data
